name: Global Gate Halong ESG++ Marathon 2026
short_description: Global Gate Halong ESG++ Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Vinhomes Global Gate in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, over 3 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Global Gate Halong ESG++ Marathon 2026 takes place on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Global Gate Ha Long, a Vingroup development in Quang Ninh, with the expo on 10 October. DHA Vietnam is the organiser named on the event page. The race offers 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 3 km under a Net Zero theme, and the organisers are aiming for 24,000 runners.

faqs.question: What are the age limits for each distance at Global Gate Halong ESG++ Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The 42 km is open to runners aged 18 and over, the 21 km to those 16 and over, and the 10 km to those 12 and over. The 3 km has no age limit, but children under five must run with an adult, and that adult also needs a 3 km ticket.

faqs.question: Can I transfer my entry or change distance for Global Gate Halong ESG++ Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Transfers cost 300,000 VND and personal-detail changes are free. Moving up a distance has no change fee, only the price difference at the time of the change, and moving down is free but the difference is not refunded. Entry fees are not refunded if you cannot take part.
